desc:
🚗✨ Belo Horizonte ✨🏰

Explore the automotive magic in Belo Horizonte, where the streets transform into enchanted tracks and competition goes beyond speed. In the heart of the city, build your dream garage, customizing magical cars and unlocking unique spells.


Customize every detail of your vehicles, from the shiny bodywork to the charms that confer special powers. Challenge skillful opponents, win exciting races and immerse yourself in the landscapes of Belo Horizonte.

* Buy the gamepass to get access to luxury houses in the game ! *

Feel the adrenaline of building your dream garage in a city full of magic and mystery. In Belo Horizonte, competition is magical, speed is enchanted, and the streets of the mining capital await you. Get ready for a unique and fascinating automotive experience! 🌆🌟🔧
